title: Easy remote job, start tonight
scenario: A recruiter texts you about a remote “data optimization” job paying daily. You can start tonight by rating products in an app. After a few small payouts, the app says you must deposit your own money to unlock higher-paying tasks.

answers.A: Deposit only enough to complete one more task so you can withdraw the larger balance.
answers.B: Stop; do not deposit money. Verify the employer independently and report/block the job contact.
answers.C: Withdraw any funds you legitimately can without paying more, then stop using the platform.

explanation: Task scams often show fake earnings and may pay a little first to build trust before demanding deposits.
proTip: A job that requires you to pay to unlock pay is not a job.
